newsitem.title: ITALY: Mother killed in Naples street shootout.
newsitem.headline: Mother killed in Naples street shootout.

text.p: Two people were killed, one of them a mother walking home with her six-year-old son, when gunmen opened fire in a busy street in the southern Italian port of Naples on Wednesday, police said.
The dead were named as Salvatore Raimondi, who had a previous record for petty crime, and 39-year-old Silvia Ruotolo, who was shot within metres of her front door in a narrow hillside street.
Two others were seriously injured, one of them a student who was hit in the back as other bystanders sought refuge behind parked cars. It was not clear how many gunmen were involved.

Police said Raimondi, 31, and Luigi Filippini, 35, who also had a criminal record and was injured, were believed to have been the targets of the attack, probably linked to the local Naples Mafia known as the Camorra.
News agencies said the deaths brought the number of murders committed in the Naples area this year to 75.
